name: Memchats API
description: REST API for the Memchats conversation memory and for Alma, the single counsellor who answers about a contact. Alma covers four areas (legal, relaciones, conocer, negocio) and picks one from who the contact is and what the exchange is about. No area depends on the plan: all four are available on every plan, Free included. Plans differ in how many Alma analyses per week they allow, how many contacts can be kept, and how deep the answer goes.
